descricao: Offers this line as a sending channel for your Bitrix24 marketing campaigns.
avisoRotulo: Bitrix24 only accepts providers of type SMS: this line will show up under the SMS menu, in Marketing → SMS campaign, even though it delivers over WhatsApp.
avisoBloqueio: This is an unofficial WhatsApp line. Bulk sending carries a real risk of Meta blocking the number, and that also takes down one-to-one support on this line.
statusRegistrado: This line already shows up as a provider in your campaigns.
statusNaoRegistrado: This line does not show up in your campaigns yet.
indisponivel: Campaign sending is not available in this environment. Contact support.
confirmarTitulo: Confirm using this line in campaigns
confirmarDescricao: This is an unofficial WhatsApp line. Sending a campaign to many contacts at once increases the risk of Meta blocking the number — and that also takes down one-to-one support on this line.
confirmarCiencia: I understand the risk of the number being blocked and want to offer this line in campaigns.
removerDescricao: This line stops showing up in the provider list of your SMS campaigns. Campaigns scheduled for it stop finding it.
registrado: Line available in your SMS campaigns.
registroIndisponivel: Nothing changed: campaign sending is not available in this environment.
erroLeitura: Could not check the campaign provider for this line.
erroRegistro: Could not offer this line in campaigns.
erroRemocao: Could not remove this line from campaigns.
bloqueadaHint: This line has no active subscription, so it cannot be offered in campaigns.
erroSituacao: Could not check the subscription for this line, so campaign actions are locked.

bloqueada.trialDescricao: You can see how this line is set up in campaigns, but you cannot offer or remove it until there is a subscription.
bloqueada.inativaDescricao: This line has no active subscription. Campaign actions are locked until the subscription is sorted out.
